d: What is Schrödinger's cat? In this video, we explain the most famous thought experiment in physics — from why Erwin Schrödinger imagined a cat that is both alive and dead at the same time, to the EPR paradox, quantum superposition, the Copenhagen interpretation, and why the experiment was designed to expose a fundamental problem with quantum mechanics. Learn about the 1935 Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen paper, quantum entanglement, and why Schrödinger never actually believed the cat was both alive and dead.
